Fallacies
• Green because nickel. Current spectroscopy of 3I ATLAS detects neutral nickel and cyanide increasing steeply as it nears the Sun, but neither species explains a green visual glow. Comet green is classically from diatomic carbon C2 Swan bands near 516 nm. VLT reports so far found CN and Ni but no C2 or C3. The recent public images are multi filter composites not calibrated true color, so apparent green is likely processing rather than Ni driven emission. 
• Tail is turning green. Peer reviewed work shows comet tails do not appear green because UV sunlight breaks up C2 in the coma before it can flow into the tail. No published observation has shown a genuinely green tail for 3I ATLAS. Claims based on processed images should be treated as non physical color.

• What 3I ATLAS is. NASA classifies it as the third confirmed interstellar comet. Perihelion about 30 Oct 2025 at roughly 1.4 au. Closest to Earth about 1.8 au. 
• Chemistry seen so far. VLT spectroscopy detected rising CN and numerous Ni I lines while Fe I was undetected. Latest quoted values near 2.85 au were log Q CN ≈ 23.61 s^-1 and log Q Ni ≈ 22.67 s^-1. 
• Imaging status. Gemini South images show a growing coma and tail but colors come from stacked red green blue and ultraviolet filters rather than a single true color exposure.

• Color uncertainty. To claim a physical green coma or tail you need spectroscopic detection of C2 near 516 nm or a rigorously calibrated RGB image tied to spectral bands. As of the latest VLT paper C2 was not detected, so the green look in some pictures is not yet a confirmed physical property. What would change my mind.
